title: Onias the high priest
summary: Onias the high priest is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Iewes and Daniel, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 3820. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 3820 = 213 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 793b
calculated.arithmetic: Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 3820. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 3820 = 213 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad.

birth.date: 333. yeeres after the foundation by Onias
birth.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter III, §. II, sig. 174a–174b
birth.note: Body intake. The yeeres from his foundation of the temple in Egypt until Vespasian. Not his reign, and not a yeere of the World. No temple event was made. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 793b
reign.note: Year cell "4502 3820". To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 39 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row.
